leftEvidence.title: A scarlet robe, a crown, and mock homage

points.label: Action and sequence
points.left: The governor’s soldiers gather, clothe Jesus, crown him with thorns, mock his kingship, strike him, restore his clothes, and lead him away.
points.right: Soldiers call together the cohort, use purple and thorns, salute Jesus as king, strike and spit, and then lead him out.

points.label: Evidence boundary
points.left: The passage materially bears on the Crucifixion while leaving part of its motive, mechanism, or later significance unstated.
points.right: This witness selects its own people, actions, words, and sequence around the Crucifixion without explaining every difference from the other witnesses.

payload.posture: Matthew and Mark independently preserve the soldiers’ mock kingship sequence.

rightEvidence.title: Purple, thorns, blows, and a salute

payload.tension: Both name thorns, salute, blows, and removal of the costume while differing in clothing description and selected gestures.
payload.title: Scarlet robe / purple robe
